evidence.definition_de: die Gültigkeit einer Regel oder Vorschrift beenden

confirmed_findings.finding: The learner structure treats the construction as slotless although the thing whose validity is ended is a central variable object in the definition and all four examples.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Preserve the raw source surface in provenance and expose the theme/object in learner structure, e.g. 'etw. außer Kraft setzen'.

confirmed_findings.finding: The learner structure omits the variable object that is put into force, despite the definition and every example explicitly realizing that role.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Preserve the source surface and add the theme/object to learner structure, e.g. 'etw. in Kraft setzen'.

evidence.definition_de: militärisch gegen einen anderen Staat oder Gegner kämpfen

confirmed_findings.finding: The English learner layer calques German mit+Dat. as 'wage war with'. In ordinary English the action is naturally expressed as waging war against/on an opponent; 'be at war with' is a different construction.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Keep the German source rection unchanged, but make the English gloss/examples idiomatic with 'wage war against/on ...' where appropriate.

evidence.example_de: Nach der Schulung war sie in der Lage, das Programm selbstständig zu bedienen.
evidence.example_fa: او پس از آموزش قادر بود برنامه را مستقلاً کار کند.

confirmed_findings.finding: The Persian sentence is grammatically and idiomatically awkward: 'برنامه را ... کار کند' is a German-shaped rendering rather than natural Persian for operating/using a program.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Use natural Persian such as working with/using the program independently, while preserving the German content.

evidence.definition_de: etwas vom Wasser ans Ufer oder an festen Boden bringen

confirmed_findings.finding: The learner structure hides the central variable person/thing being brought ashore, even though the definition and all four examples realize it.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Add the theme/object participant (jdn./etw.) to learner structure while preserving the exact source surface in provenance.

evidence.definition_de: zusätzliches Gebiet oder neuen Boden gewinnen
evidence.meaning_fa: زمین یا قلمرو به دست آوردن
evidence.example_scope: all four examples are literal land-reclamation/territory uses

confirmed_findings.finding: The registered source classifies this target as an idiom, but the learner layer teaches only the literal land/territory sense. The idiomatic colloquial sense is absent, so source classification and learner sense coverage are misaligned.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Preserve the one-card identity and source classification. Add the idiomatic sense and suitable examples; retain the literal sense only as an additional meaning if intentionally supported.

confirmed_findings.finding: The structure is marked as slotless although the idiom requires a variable person/thing obtained or recruited; every example realizes that object.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Expose jdn./etw. as the learner argument slot while leaving the source surface unchanged in provenance.

evidence.definition_de: etwas gründen, schaffen oder erstmals organisieren

confirmed_findings.finding: The variable entity that is founded/created is core to the construction, yet learner structure exposes no object slot.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Add the theme/object, e.g. 'etw. ins Leben rufen', without altering source provenance.

confirmed_findings.finding: The Persian coordination is grammatically incomplete: 'انتقاد' lacks its verb while it is coordinated with 'بدوبیراه گفتن'.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Use a complete idiomatic Persian formulation such as 'شدیداً انتقاد کردن یا بدوبیراه گفتن'.

examples_de: Der Verkäufer führte die Kundin mit falschen Angaben hinters Licht.
Er hatte seine Kollegen monatelang hinters Licht geführt.
Mit der gefälschten Website wurden viele Nutzer hinters Licht geführt.
Sie merkte erst später, dass man sie bei der Abrechnung hinters Licht geführt hatte.

confirmed_findings.finding: The source/canonical layer encodes dative 'jdm.', but standard German uses accusative 'jdn. hinters Licht führen'. All four learner examples already use the accusative, creating a direct canonical/structure-versus-example contradiction.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Preserve the raw source surface verbatim in provenance, add an explicit evidence-backed source-repair record, and normalize learner canonical/structure to accusative 'jdn.'.

confirmed_findings.canonical_form: in der ersten / zweiten … Liga spielen

evidence.example1_en: The club has been playing in the first league since this season.
evidence.example3_en: In sporting terms, the team only plays in the second league, but financially it is doing well.

confirmed_findings.finding: In generic English sports wording, 'first league/second league' is German-influenced; 'top/first division' and 'second division' are the natural generic terms unless an official league name is meant.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Rewrite the literal sports examples with idiomatic English division terminology; the metaphorical 'same/different league' examples can remain.

evidence.definition_de: sich auf die Lippe beißen, oft um eine Äußerung oder Reaktion zurückzuhalten

confirmed_findings.finding: The German definition repeats the target expression as its own definition and only adds a common purpose. It therefore does not independently explain the action and is a residual circular-definition defect.
confirmed_findings.repair_direction: Replace the circular opening with an independent explanation of biting/pressing one's lip with the teeth, optionally retaining the pragmatic purpose of suppressing speech or reaction.
